title: Bump actions/stale from 4 to 6
body:
Bumps [actions/stale](https://github.com/actions/stale) from 4 to 6.
Release notes

Sourced from actions/stale's releases.

v6.0.0

:warning: Breaking change :warning:

Issues/PRs default close-issue-reason is now not_planned(#789)

V5.2.0

Features: New option include-only-assigned enables users to process only issues/PRs that are already assigned. If there is no assignees and this option is set, issue will not be processed per: issue/596

Fixes: Fix date comparison edge case PR/816

Dependency Updates: PR/812

Fix issue when days-before-close is more than days-before-stale

fixes a bug introduced in #717

fixed in #775

v5.1.0

[5.1.0]

Don't process stale issues right after they're marked stale Add close-issue-reason option #764#772 Various dependabot/dependency updates

v5.0.0

Features

  • Update Runtime to node16

v4.1.0

Features

  • Ability to exempt draft PRs
Changelog

Sourced from actions/stale's changelog.

Changelog

[6.0.0]

:warning: Breaking change :warning:

Issues/PRs default close-issue-reason is now not_planned(#789)

[5.1.0]

Don't process stale issues right after they're marked stale [Add close-issue-reason option]#764#772 Various dependabot/dependency updates

Commits
  • 3de2653 Update changelog for v6.0.0 (#829)
  • 02e44c8 fix(options)!: Make not_planned the default close-issue-reason (#807)
  • 99b6c70 Add include-only-assigned to the action.yml (#824)
  • 8e8a0e6 [Bugfix-795] Fix date comparison edge case (#816)
  • 80962c1 Update README.md (#821)
  • 3e4418e Issue 596/include only assigned (#817)
  • 33e3703 Update actions core to 1.9.1 (#812)
  • 97911cb Update package.lock version (#811)
  • 65afee9 docs(readme): add missing permission for delete-branch option in readme (#796)
  • 48bae59 build(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 1 to 3 (#761)
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view
